title: If Aaron Donald returns, he won't recognize many of his teammates

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: If Aaron Donald returns, he won't recognize many of his teammates
sources.description: If/when future Hall of Fame defensive tackle Aaron Donald resets the five-year clock on his induction to zero, he'll join a team that has nearly zero defensive starters from the last time he played.
